Chat8VC is our monthly series bringing together forward-thinking technologists to showcase their work -- from applications leveraging foundation models to the tools enabling the AI wave.

It's a meeting ground for precise technical insights and practical inspiration, where today's prototypes lay the groundwork for tomorrow's breakthroughs.
[OVERVIEW]
Global value creation is driven by paradigm shifts and we are in the middle of one right now.

‍What will you build?
[PERSPECTIVE]
CHAT8VC VIDEO
Past Events
INTERVIEW
MAY 9, 2025
Charles Srisuwananukorn (Together AI) Fireside Chat

We were thrilled to feature Charles Srisuwananukorn from Together AI at January’s Chat8VC. Charles is the Founding Vice President of Engineering at Together AI, where he leads the company’s work on AI infrastructure and clusters. Previously, he was Head of Applied Machine Learning at Snorkel AI and held engineering roles at Apple. He studied Computer Science at Stanford and has helped steer Together from an early contributor to open-source AI to a full-stack infra platform.

INTERVIEW
MAY 6, 2025
Joe Chen and Jonathan Shen (Upwork) Fireside Chat

We were thrilled to feature Joe and Jonathan from Upwork at March's Chat8VC in San Francisco. We covered their journey from teams like Google Brain and Cruise, and their own startup, to leading AI efforts at Upwork—building Uma, a suite of specialized LLMs powering workflows for freelancers and clients across the platform.

INTERVIEW
SEPTEMBER 3, 2024
Ramp & Vercel Fireside Chat

We were thrilled to host June's Chat8VC event alongside our portfolio companies Ramp & Vercel in NY. We were honored to feature Nik Koblov (Head of Engineering) and Nico Bevacqua (Head of UI / UX Engineering) from Ramp as well as Guillermo Rauch (CEO) and Lee Robinson (VP Product) from Vercel for a discussion anchored around the future of frontend engineering.

INTERVIEW
APRIL 25, 2024
Karim Atiyeh and Nik Koblov (Ramp) Fireside Chat

Today, we’re pleased to share the transcript from that conversation. Karim and Nik share numerous insights on Ramp’s journey, which recently marked five years and over $1 billion in customer savings. They explain how Ramp has been guided by the same mission since their first prototype, how they’ve achieved and maintained product/market fit, how they’ve built and sustained a dynamic and collaborative talent culture, and where AI has (and hasn’t) factored into their product evolution.

INTERVIEW
FEBRUARY 7, 2024
Nik Spirin (NVIDIA) Fireside Chat

For our final Chat8VC of 2023, we hosted Dr. Nik Spirin, Director of Generative AI and LLMOps at NVIDIA. He sits at a very compelling vantage point in this role. Prior to NVIDIA, he was a serial entrepreneur, classical ML PhD, and researcher by training who worked on many interesting applied AI projects at places like Gigster and played key roles in the enterprise-wide AI transformations of Canon, Dentsu, and Vodafone.

INTERVIEW
NOVEMBER 28, 2023
Michel Tricot (Airbyte) Fireside Chat

Our story is certainly full of ups and downs. Airbyte today is often associated with our open source data infrastructure project and product. It really started though in July 2019 when my co-founder and I first decided to build something together. We implemented a fairly disciplined system around idea exploration and honed in on the problem-space of data and went through YC in January ‘20, which was the famous COVID batch where we went from being in person to fully remote. 

INTERVIEW
NOVEMBER 17, 2023
Mike Del Balso (Tecton) Fireside Chat

At our September Chat8VC gathering, we hosted Mike Del Balso, founder and CEO of Tecton and a visionary behind Uber's Michelangelo, for a conversation with 8VC Partner Bhaskar Ghosh. As a reminder, Chat8VC is a monthly series hosted at our SF office where we bring together founders and early-phase operators excited about the foundation model ecosystem. We focus on having highly technical, implementation-oriented conversations and give founders and builders the opportunity to showcase what they’re working on through lightning demos and fireside chats. This can be a fun side project, related to a company they’re starting, or a high-leverage use case within a company operating at scale. 

INTERVIEW
NOVEMBER 6, 2023
Tome Fireside Chat

In the spirit of sharing some lessons from our events, earlier this year we had the pleasure of hosting Keith Peiris and Henri Liriani, the co-founders of Tome, at our monthly Chat8VC gatherings in April.

INTERVIEW
SEPTEMBER 21, 2023
Amjad Masad (Replit) Fireside Chat

We were delighted to engage in a dynamic conversation with Amjad Masad, founder and CEO of Replit during our August Chat8VC gathering. As a reminder, Chat8VC is a monthly series hosted at our SF office where we bring together founders and early-phase operators excited about the foundation model ecosystem. We focus on having highly technical, implementation-oriented conversations and give founders and builders the opportunity to showcase what they’re working on through lightning demos and fireside chats. This can be a fun side project, related to a company they’re starting, or a high-leverage use case within a company operating at scale. 

INTERVIEW
JULY 18, 2023
Knowledge Management & Retrieval -- Fireside Chat with Mem & Shortwave

We were delighted to engage in a dynamic conversation with Andrew Lee (co-founder/CEO of Shortwave) and Dennis Xu (co-founder/CEO of Mem) during our June Chat8VC gathering. As a reminder, Chat8VC is a monthly series hosted at our SF office where we bring together founders and early-phase operators excited about the foundation model ecosystem. We focus on having highly technical, implementation-oriented conversations and give founders and builders the opportunity to showcase what they’re working on through lightning demos and fireside chats. This can be a fun side project, related to a company they’re starting, or a high-leverage use case within a company operating at scale.

/* Snippet gets rid of top margin on first element in any rich text*/
.w-richtext>:first-child {
	margin-top: 0;
}

/* Snippet gets rid of bottom margin on last element in any rich text*/
.w-richtext>:last-child, .w-richtext ol li:last-child, .w-richtext ul li:last-child {
	margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* Snippet prevents all click and hover interaction with an element */
.clickable-off {
	pointer-events: none;
}

/* Snippet enables all click and hover interaction with an element */
.clickable-on{
  pointer-events: auto;
}

/* Snippet enables you to add class of div-square which creates and maintains a 1:1 dimension of a div.*/
.div-square::after {
	content: "";
	display: block;
	padding-bottom: 100%;
}

/*Hide focus outline for main content element*/
main:focus-visible {

}

/* Make sure containers never lose their center alignment*/
.container-medium, .container-small, .container-large {

}

        ele.style.top = (navHeight - 1) + "px"
    })
}
//button-second-text.js
//the text for the second line is duplicated for all buttons

let allButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.button');
let allExternalButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.external-button');

allButtons.forEach(button => {
    let mainTextContent = button.querySelector('.button-text_content');
    let secondTextContent = button.querySelector('.is-second');

    if (secondTextContent !== null) {
        secondTextContent.textContent = mainTextContent.textContent;
    }
});
  
allExternalButtons.forEach(button => {
    let mainTextContent = button.querySelector('.button-text_content');
    let secondTextContent = button.querySelector('.is-second');

    if (secondTextContent !== null) {
        secondTextContent.textContent = mainTextContent.textContent;
    }
});  

//menu-quick-links.js
//Adds menu animation, because there were some bugs in webflow

let menuStatus = true;
document.querySelector('.nav-button').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (menuStatus == true) {
        document.querySelector('.nav_quick-links').classList.toggle('nav_quick-links--hidden');
        menuStatus = false;
    } else {
        setTimeout(() => {
            document.querySelector('.nav_quick-links').classList.toggle('nav_quick-links--hidden');
        }, 1500);
        menuStatus = true;
    }
});



// Hide collection list if there are no items in collection
document.querySelectorAll(".w-dyn-empty").forEach(ele => {
  if(ele.parentElement.children.length == 1){
    ele.closest(".w-dyn-list").style.display = "none";
  }
})

// Add condition visibility to dots and line in resource/blog card
let resource_dots = document.querySelectorAll(`[data-element-dot]`)
if(resource_dots.length > 0){
    resource_dots.forEach(dot => {
        let format_text = dot.closest('.card-tag').querySelector('[data-element-format]')
        let category_text = dot.closest('.card-tag').querySelector('[data-element-category]')
        let dash_line = dot.closest('.card-tag').querySelector('[data-element-line]')
        if(format_text.offsetWidth === 0 && category_text.offsetWidth === 0){
            dot.classList.add("hide")
            dash_line.classList.add("hide")
        }
    })
}
//
let AllPageinks = document.querySelectorAll('a');
let filterPageLinks = [];
for (let i = 0; i < AllPageinks.length; i++) {
    let href = AllPageinks[i].getAttribute('href');
    let target = AllPageinks[i].getAttribute('target');
    
    if (href && !href.startsWith('#') && !href.startsWith('?') && (!target || target !== '_blank')) {
        filterPageLinks.push(AllPageinks[i]);
    }
}

$(filterPageLinks).on('click', function(event) {
    if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.shiftKey) return;
    document.querySelector('[page-transition-out]').click()
});

// Update Copyright year automatically
document.querySelector("#copyright-year-text").innerHTML = "©" + new Date().getFullYear();
</script>

Our Mission

Transforming defense capabilities with advanced technology.

The battlefield has changed. How we deter & defend needs to change too.

Security threats are evolving at machine speed. To keep pace, Anduril puts products ahead of process and builds technology to bring the United States and partners quantum leaps ahead in capability.


Learn more about our mission
Rebuild the Arsenal

America’s defense industrial base, which has helped to deter war and maintain peace for decades is being left behind. The arsenal we need is an order of magnitude more than we can build at present. We need a different approach to generating military power. The good news is this is now possible. See how Anduril is disrupting defense production, and how you can get involved.

Learn more on rebuildthearsenal.com

Lattice

Autonomy for Every Mission

Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice, an AI-powered, open operating system that brings autonomy to defense's toughest missions. Lattice connects autonomous sensemaking and command & control capabilities with open, modular, and scalable hardware components for a layered family of systems approach.


Start Building with Lattice SDK
Learn More about Lattice Mesh
Autonomous All Domain Force Protection

A family of autonomous systems, powered by Lattice, that provide integrated, persistent awareness and security across land, sea and air, all at the tactical edge.

Counter UAS

No threat goes unseen. Anduril’s open Counter UAS system is built to detect, track and intercept unmanned aircraft and autonomous drone systems.

Barracuda​

Purpose-Built to Bring Mass to the Fight ​

Barracuda is a family of air-breathing Autonomous Air Vehicles (AAVs) purpose-built for hyper-scale production and mass employment. Barracuda-M is the munition configuration of Barracuda that delivers a more affordable, producible, available, and adaptable cruise missile capability than existing options available to warfighters today.​

​

Learn More About Barracuda

Twin-Turbojet VTOL Autonomous Air Vehicle (AAV)

Roadrunner

Twin-Turbojet VTOL Autonomous Air Vehicle (AAV)

Roadrunner is a reusable vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) Autonomous Air Vehicle (AAV) with twin turbojet engines and modular payload configurations that can support a variety of missions.

Learn More About Roadrunner

Fury

Autonomous Air Vehicle

Fury is a high-performance, multi-mission Autonomous Air Vehicle (AAV) built for the high-end fight.

Learn More about Fury

Autonomous Air Systems

Autonomous Air Systems

Autonomous air systems that are all tasked, connected, and controlled by Lattice. Together, they enable a variety of intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, and targeting mission profiles.

Learn More About Ghost
Learn More About Altius
Autonomous Underwater Vehicles

Dive-LD is the most reliable and flexible Autonomous Underwater Vehicle. It enables safe and successful access to the greatest depths of the world’s oceans.

Learn More About Dive-LD

Careers

Join us in creating the future of defense.

From light bulb to functional prototype in a week. An engineer’s playground where we make what we feel is right and needs to exist. A dedicated team rallying around a shared intention to make a positive impact by creating a safer world. That’s life at Anduril.

Hopscotch Primary Care is bringing a new level of primary care to rural communities that goes above and beyond, with an initial focus on expanding access and care for Medicare and Medicare/Medicaid patients.

Become a Patient
WE DELIVER CARE THAT GOES ABOVE AND BEYOND
About Us

Our mission is to transform lives in rural communities through accessible and proactive value-based care. We are committed to delivering exceptional care for seniors, both in our clinics and beyond. We support our patients with more resources, time, and the attention of a full care team.

Learn More
YOUR PARTNER IN SENIOR HEALTHCARE
Who We Serve

Hopscotch specializes on serving the needs of patients with Medicare, including most Medicare Advantage plans, Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Supplement or Medigap plans, and Medicare/Medicaid Plans.

At Hopscotch, we know the importance of building a community of care centered around the needs of our patients, and we strive to support our patients, care team members, and other partners within the healthcare community.

Patients

Our patients are at the heart of everything we do. We offer high-quality, comprehensive care for seniors with Medicare or Medicare/Medicaid. Our physicians and care teams focus on building strong relationships, taking the time to get to know you, and listening to your questions and concerns.

Learn More
Partners

We support partnerships that power possibilities. At Hopscotch, we believe in the importance of working with both local and broader groups to ensure patients get the care and support they need, where and when they need it most.

Learn More
Careers

At Hopscotch Primary Care, we are bringing better access and high-quality care to rural communities across America. To make this happen, we need a world-class team. If you are team-first, mission-driven, and bring skill, passion, and dedication to everything you do, we’d love to meet you.

Learn More
THE HOPSCOTCH PRIMARY CARE DIFFERENCE
Our Values

At Hopscotch Primary Care, our true north is serving our patients and the care teams who serve them. Our culture is what unifies us, underpins everything we do, and ultimately lays the foundation for us to achieve our mission and vision.

We believe that when you invest in culture, commit to values, and hand good people the possibility, great things happen.

Senior Primary Care, Powered by Relationships

Hopscotch Primary Care is bringing a new level of primary care to rural communities that goes above and beyond, with an initial focus on expanding access and care for Medicare and Medicare/Medicaid patients.

Become a Patient

We Deliver Care That Goes Above and Beyond

About Us

Our mission is to transform lives in rural communities through accessible and proactive value-based care. We are committed to delivering exceptional care for seniors, both in our clinics and beyond. We support our patients with more resources, time, and the attention of a full care team.

Learn More

Your Partner in Senior Healthcare

Who We Serve

Hopscotch specializes on serving the needs of patients with Medicare, including most Medicare Advantage plans, Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Supplement or Medigap plans, and Medicare/Medicaid Plans.

At Hopscotch, we know the importance of building a community of care centered around the needs of our patients, and we strive to support our patients, care team members, and other partners within the healthcare community.

Patients

Our patients are at the heart of everything we do. We offer high-quality, comprehensive care for seniors with Medicare or Medicare/Medicaid. Our physicians and care teams focus on building strong relationships, taking the time to get to know you, and listening to your questions and concerns.

Learn More

Partners

We support partnerships that power possibilities. At Hopscotch, we believe in the importance of working with both local and broader groups to ensure patients get the care and support they need, where and when they need it most.

Learn More

Careers

At Hopscotch Primary Care, we are bringing better access and high-quality care to rural communities across America. To make this happen, we need a world-class team. If you are team-first, mission-driven, and bring skill, passion, and dedication to everything you do, we’d love to meet you.

Learn More

The Hopscotch Primary Care Difference

Our Values

At Hopscotch Primary Care, our true north is serving our patients and the care teams who serve them. Our culture is what unifies us, underpins everything we do, and ultimately lays the foundation for us to achieve our mission and vision.

We believe that when you invest in culture, commit to values, and hand good people the possibility, great things happen.

Personalized Care
Full Care Team
More Time with Your Doctor
Support Beyond the Clinic

Hear From Our Patients

Testimonials

Don’t just take our word for it! Hear what our patients have to say about their experience with Hopscotch Primary Care.

Hopscotch Primary Care patient

Hopscotch Primary Care patient

The whole team is fabulous. We are so grateful for Hopscotch. You are an amazing organization. We hope your service continues to expand throughout NC, and beyond. You are what healthcare should be in the USA!

Hopscotch Primary Care patient

Get Started with Hopscotch Primary Care

Experience the Hopscotch difference today. Contact us to learn more about our Medicare and Medicare/Medicaid focused primary care services, or to become a patient.

CoCounsel: The industry-leading GenAI assistant for professionals

Built by industry experts, backed by authoritative content, and equipped with best-in-class security, CoCounsel frees you to focus on high-value work that better serves your clients and business

Legal professionals 

Tax, audit, and accounting professionals 

CoCounsel is your trusted partner, supporting you every step of the way

Focus more on complex, strategic work using professional-grade GenAI with agentic workflows built to amplify your expertise.

View video

Work smarter with AI

Now, professionals can delegate substantive work to a GenAI assistant. CoCounsel provides:

A fluid connection to the solutions you work in every day; it understands context and nuance across products and workflows, allowing you to derive more in-depth insights faster than ever.
Access to the most innovative large-language models (LLMs) backed by the industry's most trusted and reliable content.
Integration with industry-leading platforms such as Westlaw, Practical Law, Checkpoint, Microsoft 365, and document management system partners. 
Expert technology

Deliver results faster than ever before with technology engineered by over 1,000 GenAI and machine-learning (ML) experts.

Data privacy

Operate confidently knowing your sensitive data is secure, private, and not being used to train artificial intelligence models.

Trustworthy AI

Transform your legal work with generative AI grounded in trusted content, maintained by experts who focus on limiting inaccuracies and algorithmic bias.

Secure processing

Protect your client’s sensitive data during transit and storage with industry-standard protocols and encryption.

Professionals are choosing CoCounsel

"I think it's exponentially less time, because you don't know where to start sometimes to get answers. With AI-Assisted Research on CoCounsel, you don't have to worry about where to go. You just ask, and you get a response. It's concentrated in one place instead of looking at five different places." 

Founding partner
Mid-size law firm

“I used to spend an hour on this tax process, but with CoCounsel doing 80% of the work for me, I'm able to enjoy using judgment and reasoning when finishing the project since the mundane research is done for me.”

Tax partner
Top U.S. 100 firm

Frequently asked questions
What is the difference between CoCounsel, CoCounsel branded products, and existing Thomson Reuters products enhanced by CoCounsel?

CoCounsel is the GenAI assistant for professionals, available wherever you work within the Thomson Reuters ecosystem or integrated platforms such as Microsoft 365.
 
CoCounsel branded products offer unique skills, such as Search a Database and Review Documents within CoCounsel Core. CoCounsel can also focus on assisting in a specific area of work like faster drafting within CoCounsel Drafting.

Existing Thomson Reuters products enhanced by CoCounsel are standalone products that integrate CoCounsel to facilitate specific tasks, such as Westlaw Precision with CoCounsel’s AI-Assisted Research, helping users save time and maximize the value of their access to our trusted content.

Does Thomson Reuters or its third parties retain user content or prompts to train their GenAI-based products or underlying large-language models (LLM)?

No. Your user content and prompts are not used to train or improve CoCounsel and associated products or LLMs, used in Thomson Reuters or third-party output, or stored by OpenAI or Google.

Thomson Reuters GenAI third-party partners, such as OpenAI and Google, are contractually prohibited from using any customer data to train their models. Additionally, where applicable, we have established systemic controls to turn off third parties' abuse-monitoring solutions to ensure there is no human access to Thomson Reuters customers' data or inclusion of that data in third-party models.

How long does Thomson Reuters retain user content and prompts?

Retention of user content and prompts is customized to fit customer needs and set up at the organization account level with the support of a Thomson Reuters client manager. We then delete user content and prompts in accordance with the customer's retention policy. Users can delete their content and prompts in the product at any time. 

How does Thomson Reuters protect user privacy and data?

All GenAI LLM requests originating from Thomson Reuters are processed under the identity "Thomson Reuters," never identifying the Thomson Reuters customer who made the request. We secure all data in transit via TLS 1.2, and symmetric encryption (AES-256) protects data at rest. All interactions with GenAI LLM providers use zero-retention API calls.

Where are user content and user prompts stored when retained?

Systematic procedures and hosting are in the U.S. We process all interactions with OpenAI GPT and Google Gemini in the U.S. We host backup data in separate availability time zones in the U.S.*

*Region-based hosting is available in the UK, Australia, and Canada.

What guardrails are in place to prevent bias in Thomson Reuters content?

We have developed and implemented prompting "guardrails," ensuring our GenAI-based products will only produce responses from content drawn from a clearly defined and limited set of verified information, such as our own content databases. This practice restricts the large language model's ability to produce potentially objectionable content broadly sourced from the internet.

                What is the difference between CoCounsel, CoCounsel branded products, and existing Thomson Reuters products enhanced by CoCounsel?
                
            <dig-icon class="dig-accordion--icon dig-icon hydrated" aria-hidden="true"><dig-svg class="tr-svg hydrated" style="height: 16px;"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" focusable="false" style="height: 16px; width: 16px;"><title>down arrow</title><g stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linejoin="round" class="nc-icon-wrapper"><polyline points="2,7 12,17 22,7 " transform="translate(0, 0)"></polyline></g></svg></dig-svg></dig-icon></button><dig-accordion-panel slot="panel" value="_root_container_copy_61054296_container_1689392523_accordion_547511501_accordionItems_item0" class="hydrated"><!---->
                    
                <div class="dig-accordion-panel dig-accordion-panel--hidden"><div slot="content">
                        <dig-typography semantic="" variant="bodyMedium" color="secondary" element="p" class="dig-typography dig-typography--body-medium dig-typography--alignment-start dig-typography--color-secondary hydrated"><!---->
                            <p>CoCounsel is the GenAI assistant for professionals, available wherever you work within the Thomson Reuters ecosystem or integrated platforms such as Microsoft 365.<br>
 <br>
CoCounsel branded products offer unique skills, such as Search a Database and Review Documents within CoCounsel Core. CoCounsel can also focus on assisting in a specific area of work like faster drafting within CoCounsel Drafting.<br>
<br>
Existing Thomson Reuters products enhanced by CoCounsel are standalone products that integrate CoCounsel to facilitate specific tasks, such as Westlaw Precision with CoCounsel’s AI-Assisted Research, helping users save time and maximize the value of their access to our trusted content.</p>
                        </dig-typography>
                    </div></div></dig-accordion-panel></dig-accordion-item><dig-accordion-item slot="item" value="_root_container_copy_61054296_container_1689392523_accordion_547511501_accordionItems_item1" class="dig-accordion-item hydrated"><!----><button tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">
                Does Thomson Reuters or its third parties retain user content or prompts to train their GenAI-based products or underlying large-language models (LLM)?
                
            <dig-icon class="dig-accordion--icon dig-icon hydrated" aria-hidden="true"><dig-svg class="tr-svg hydrated" style="height: 16px;"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" focusable="false" style="height: 16px; width: 16px;"><title>down arrow</title><g stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linejoin="round" class="nc-icon-wrapper"><polyline points="2,7 12,17 22,7 " transform="translate(0, 0)"></polyline></g></svg></dig-svg></dig-icon></button><dig-accordion-panel slot="panel" value="_root_container_copy_61054296_container_1689392523_accordion_547511501_accordionItems_item1" class="hydrated"><!---->
                    
                <div class="dig-accordion-panel dig-accordion-panel--hidden"><div slot="content">
                        <dig-typography semantic="" variant="bodyMedium" color="secondary" element="p" class="dig-typography dig-typography--body-medium dig-typography--alignment-start dig-typography--color-secondary hydrated"><!---->
                            <p>No. Your user content and prompts are not used to train or improve CoCounsel and associated products or LLMs, used in Thomson Reuters or third-party output, or stored by OpenAI or Google.<br>
<br>
Thomson Reuters GenAI third-party partners, such as OpenAI and Google, are contractually prohibited from using any customer data to train their models. Additionally, where applicable, we have established systemic controls to turn off third parties' abuse-monitoring solutions to ensure there is no human access to Thomson Reuters customers' data or inclusion of that data in third-party models.</p>
                        </dig-typography>
                    </div></div></dig-accordion-panel></dig-accordion-item><dig-accordion-item slot="item" value="_root_container_copy_61054296_container_1689392523_accordion_547511501_accordionItems_item2" class="dig-accordion-item hydrated"><!----><button tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">
                How long does Thomson Reuters retain user content and prompts?
                
            <dig-icon class="dig-accordion--icon dig-icon hydrated" aria-hidden="true"><dig-svg class="tr-svg hydrated" style="height: 16px;"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" focusable="false" style="height: 16px; width: 16px;"><title>down arrow</title><g stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linejoin="round" class="nc-icon-wrapper"><polyline points="2,7 12,17 22,7 " transform="translate(0, 0)"></polyline></g></svg></dig-svg></dig-icon></button><dig-accordion-panel slot="panel" value="_root_container_copy_61054296_container_1689392523_accordion_547511501_accordionItems_item2" class="hydrated"><!---->
                    
                <div class="dig-accordion-panel dig-accordion-panel--hidden"><div slot="content">
                        <dig-typography semantic="" variant="bodyMedium" color="secondary" element="p" class="dig-typography dig-typography--body-medium dig-typography--alignment-start dig-typography--color-secondary hydrated"><!---->
                            <p>Retention of user content and prompts is customized to fit customer needs and set up at the organization account level with the support of a Thomson Reuters client manager. Get Started 
Get the care you deserve

Cityblock is a healthcare provider that exists to fill gaps. When our members have questions about their care, when they’re not sure what to do next or where to turn—that’s where we come in.

Check eligibility
Meet our insurance partners

Cityblock teams up with health insurance partners who share our values. Together, we’re building a better healthcare system—one where no one falls through the cracks.

Insurance partners
“I feel stronger now. I feel more independent.”

—Gina, Cityblock Member

Everything we do is for our members. So don’t listen to us when we talk about our care: Listen to them.

See testimonials
Get to know Cityblock

Book a visit, learn how we make a difference, work with us, and more.

Appointment request

Cityblock member? We’ll meet with you at a time and place that works for you.

Appointments
Locations

Cityblock has clinic locations on the ground in the communities we serve. Find one near you.

Find locations
Care model

Learn what makes Cityblock so different—and effective.

Learn more
For providers

Learn how Cityblock can support your practice.

Learn more
Work with us

Working at Cityblock means bringing better healthcare to those who need it most.

Learn more
Centering those we serve 

When we say “Cityblock fills gaps,” we mean that we listen to our members when they tell us what they need. Whether it’s finding a specialist, learning about their housing options, getting a medical question answered when the doctor’s office is closed—or all the above and more. Our care wraps around you.

Learn more
Primary care 

We check in with our members before they get sick, and work with them to keep them as healthy as they can be.

Mental health

Whether members want help with a specific mental health challenge or just need someone to talk to, we approach them with a listening ear and zero judgment.

Social care services

Our local teams know the resources available in their area, and use that knowledge to provide personalized support.

24/7 care line

Consult with licensed Cityblock providers for urgent care by phone 24/7. We can also bring care right to our members’ living rooms.

Coordinating between providers

We keep everyone on the same page and make sure members’ concerns are front and center.

Help reaching health goals

Our members’ goals are our goals. We do whatever we can to support them in living the lives they want, from quitting smoking or drinking to managing diabetes.

Primary care 
Mental health
Social care services
24/7 care line
Coordinating between providers
Help reaching health goals
Together with our members, we’re making real change

The relationships between Cityblock members and their Community Health Partners (CHPs) can be life-changing. In these short videos, Cityblock members share how their CHPs have made a difference to their health and happiness.

Member testimonials
“We can actually provide care that is respectful, that's trust-based ...

That's relationship-based, that seeks to affirm the autonomy of the people we're serving ... and also seeks to understand where they're coming from.”

Cityblock co-founder and CEO Dr. Toyin Ajayi saw a healthcare system that was failing her patients. So she set out to change it. That’s how Cityblock was born–to radically change how healthcare works for the people who need it most.

Our story
Cityblock care teams

When Cityblock members choose to work with us, they keep the providers and network they have through their health plan. But they also get us as a team by their side. Here’s one example of what that team can look like.

Community Health Partner (CHP)

“I’m your first stop when you need something or have questions about your health. I can connect you to social services for childcare support, housing, fresh food—you name it.

Medical Provider

“I diagnose and treat injuries or illnesses. I can provide ongoing care, especially for complex or chronic conditions.”

Therapist & Mental Health Provider

“I support you when you’re stressed out or in crisis. I help provide treatment for substance use disorders, addiction issues, and other conditions.”

Clinical Pharmacist

“I’m licensed to prescribe medications and evaluate how well they’re working. I can consult with you on what medicine might help you.”

Become one of our folx

And support Cityblock’s mission to radically improve the health of marginalized communities.

Cityblock careers
We’re here to help

Whether it’s to learn more about our services, ask questions about your membership, or to schedule a visit, call us—we’d love to hear from you. We’re available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. 

Call us now

Flexport is the platform that coordinates global logistics from factory to customer door — empowering businesses to ship anywhere, sell everywhere and grow faster.

Talk to an Expert
Hello Sofia!
From factory floor to customer door
Ocean & Air Freight

We offer ocean and air freight solutions for businesses of all sizes. Unlock the power of our global trade network to move your goods with ease. Our technology provides SKU-level visibility so you have peace of mind from origin to port. Track your shipments in real-time and manage your costs with unparalleled reliability and speed.

Customs

With Flexport Customs, our expert brokers can help you clear goods quickly, minimize import duties, and leverage customs data to benefit your entire supply chain. We'll work with you even if you don’t ship with us.

Trucking

Take the wheel of your international and domestic freight by bringing everything under one roof. As the control tower for your ground operations, we track your shipment milestones for the road ahead, from dispatch through delivery.

Fulfillment

Flexport Fulfillment provides fast, reliable DTC and B2B fulfillment. We make it easy to sell in more places with our 30+ eCommerce and retailer integrations. Plus, our Seller Portal gives you end-to-end visibility and control.

There are 4 item(s) loaded. All items has been loaded
More than 10,000 clients trust Flexport with their supply chain
Read Their Stories
We have a dedicated space for communication on each shipment, reporting tools, line level invoices — all of this information allows us to make educated decisions.

Drew Barker, VP of Operations, Bombas

Flexport Customer Since 2017

FLEXPORT OCEAN FREIGHT

Digitize freight forwarding for visibility and control

Whether you’re shipping for the first time or moving thousands of TEUs a year, Flexport optimizes speed and cost with world-class FCL and ocean consolidation services. What sets us apart are our technology and our people. We digitize and structure your supply chain data, so you can track each shipment down to the SKU, from PO creation all the way through clearance and delivery – along with an expert team supporting you every step of the way.

Explore Ocean Freight

FLEXPORT AIR FREIGHT

Take flight with flexible speed

Expedite your shipments with speed and precision. Our tailored solutions, including charter services, optimize your air freight planning with live shipment updates and actionable reports – all while keeping your costs in check. Whether you have a few critical shipments that need space or you need to move pallets with speed, we'll deliver your goods where you need them, when you need them.

Explore Air Freight

FLEXPORT TRUCKING

Handle every haul with ease

Lower your operating costs across all trucking services: drayage, cartage, FTL, and LTL. Get SKU-level visibility powered by our integrated platform, plus customized pricing through our nationwide trucking carrier network. Let us be an extension of your transportation team, from port to door.

Explore Trucking

FLEXPORT FULFILLMENT

Fuel your growth with fast, reliable fulfillment

Flexport Fulfillment offers fast, reliable delivery nationwide with 99% on-time shipping and 97%+ on-time delivery. Our end-to-end technology and data-driven demand planning take the guesswork out of inventory management, reducing costs and increasing efficiency. Our world-class operations and technology have made us a logistics partner for platforms and retailers like Shopify, Walmart, and SHEIN Marketplace.

Distributed PostgreSQL for Modern Apps

Meet YugabyteDB, the PostgreSQL-compatible distributed database for your cloud native apps. Resilient, scalable, and flexible.

01.

02.
Request a Demo
Reimagine PostgreSQL for a Cloud Native World

YugabyteDB retains all the power and familiarity of PostgreSQL by pairing its trusted API with a precision-engineered, distributed, cloud native architecture.

Even better, it’s 100% open source.

PostgreSQL++
PostgreSQL and Beyond. No Compromises.

Get instantly productive with a PostgreSQL-compatible, multi-master RDBMS that supports stored procedures, triggers, and extensions. YugabyteDB elevates PostgreSQL with built-in connection management, observability, end-to-end security, and more.

Built-in Resilience
Built-in Resilience with Flexible Disaster Recovery

Keep your application online and performant despite unplanned failures or scheduled maintenance. Meet (and exceed) your SLAs with YugabyteDB’s high availability and disaster recovery features, designed to work optimally across zones, regions, and clouds.

Scalability
Seamless Scalability

Start small and add nodes as needed. Scale your data, connections, reads, and writes effortlessly without disrupting ongoing applications. As your needs grow, YugabyteDB automatically shards data and scales in all directions (up, down, out, and in).

Global Design Patterns
Versatile Design Patterns for Global Apps

Design and deploy the perfect architecture for your global application. Choose from various blueprints and replication techniques to distribute, access, and update your data to achieve the right mix of latency, resilience, and consistency.

Enterprise Capabilities
Fit for Enterprise-Critical Applications

Deploy and run your business-critical applications with confidence. YugabyteDB offers unparalleled enterprise capabilities, including seamless migration, reliable data protection, observability, backward compatibility, and end-to-end security.

Techie Lo♡ed. Business Approved.
Whether you’re an app developer, architect, operator, or leader, YugabyteDB has you covered.
Technologists

As a technologist, you’ll enjoy:

Automatic data distribution for built-in resilience
Intelligent scaling with automatic rebalancing
Access to enterprise-grade security features
Downtime-free maintenance
Access to the rich PostgreSQL ecosystem
Explore Developer Hub
Business Leaders

As a business leader, you’ll achieve:

Lower total cost of ownership (TCO)
Database consolidation enabled by diverse workload support
Accelerated cloud native adoption with risk-free migration
Always-on business operations with reduced risks
More resources available to focus on high-priority projects
Discover YugabyteDB

TOP USE CASES

01
Database Modernization
Legacy databases were not designed for cloud native apps. Boost productivity and eliminate costly tradeoffs with a distributed RDBMS that delivers on-demand scale and built-in resilience.
02
Cloud Native Applications
YugabyteDB is ideal for Kubernetes and microservice-based apps. It runs everywhere, scales rapidly across distributed clusters, and effortlessly withstands hardware and cloud failures.
03
Edge and Streaming Apps
YugabyteDB powers global edge and streaming applications. It enables hybrid environments, eradicates data silos, and facilitates data collection from the edge and aggregation in the cloud.
Try It Yourself
How fast can you deploy YugabyteDB across multiple regions?
Here’s the scenario: You’re an engineer who needs to protect your app and data from a cloud region failure. Let’s create a synchronized, multi-region cluster to replicate data across regions.
Let’s Do It!
This demo features our powerful, multi-cloud DBaaS. Get a free account and start exploring in minutes.
Sign Up
Beyond the Technology

Yugabyte is more than a database provider; it's a partner in facilitating process transformation and organizational enablement, providing the comprehensive tools and services you need for a successful database modernization initiative.

Distributed SQL Database
Meet the database of tomorrow, today.

    max-height: 48px;

    left: 0;

    height: 48px;

    height: 24px;
  }

        opacity: 1;
        transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1);

  .intercom-lightweight-app-launcher-icon-minimize svg path {

  }

    z-index: 2147483003;
    overflow: hidden;
    background-color: #ffffff;

        width: 400px;

Our Company
Our Approach
Our Pipeline
Patients & Families
Culture & Careers
Newsroom

Orca Bio Announces Positive Results from the Pivotal Phase 3 Study of Orca-T | Read more 

Bringing precision to life
Orca Bio is on a mission to deliver the promise of cell therapy to patients without compromise

Orca Bio is a late-stage biotechnology company developing high-precision cell therapies for the treatment of cancer and autoimmune diseases. Our investigational allogeneic T-cell immunotherapies harness the power of regulatory T cells with the hope of providing better outcomes with fewer risks for patients.

Learn more
Our vision

Expanding the life-changing benefits of cell therapies.

Learn about Orca Bio

Our science

Transforming cell therapy, one cell at a time.

Discover our approach

Our pipeline

Working to deliver better outcomes through our clinical programs.

Explore our programs

At Orca Bio, we believe all patients deserve a chance at a cure
We don’t settle, and we believe patients shouldn’t have to

If you are interested in joining our team, learn about our collaborative culture and patient-driven mission.

Stay up to date with our developments—review our press releases in the newsroom.

				--akismet-color-mid-green: #357b49;

				width: auto;

				all: unset;
				box-sizing: border-box;
			}

			.a-stats strong {
				font-weight: 600;

			.a-stats a.a-stats__link,
			.a-stats a.a-stats__link:visited,
			.a-stats a.a-stats__link:active {

				color: var(--akismet-color-white);
				cursor: pointer;

				font-weight: 500;
				padding: 12px;
				text-align: center;
				text-decoration: none;
				transition: all 0.2s ease;
			}

			/* Extra specificity to deal with TwentyTwentyOne focus style */
			.widget .a-stats a.a-stats__link:focus {
				background: var(--akismet-color-mid-green);
				color: var(--akismet-color-white);
				text-decoration: none;
			}

			.a-stats a.a-stats__link:hover {

When you visit our website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, using cookies or similar tracking technology. This information may be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. More information

Manage Consent Preferences

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies enable core functionality such as security, network management, and accessibility and are necessary for our site to function. You may disable these by changing your browser settings, but this may affect how the website functions. These cookies do not store any directly identifiable information.

Functional Cookies

These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalization. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

Targeting Cookies

These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly identifiable information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less online advertising that is relevant to your interests.

Performance Cookies

These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies, we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.

MAY 9, 2025
Charles Srisuwananukorn (Together AI) Fireside Chat

We were thrilled to feature Charles Srisuwananukorn from Together AI at January’s Chat8VC. Charles is the Founding Vice President of Engineering at Together AI, where he leads the company’s work on AI infrastructure and clusters. Previously, he was Head of Applied Machine Learning at Snorkel AI and held engineering roles at Apple. He studied Computer Science at Stanford and has helped steer Together from an early contributor to open-source AI to a full-stack infra platform.

READ
READ
7 MIN
Posts
SEP 18, 2024
Introducing Global Benchmarking from Standard Metrics

8VC was founded to address major market gaps, and we’ve found several surprisingly close to home. We cofounded Affinity after seeing firsthand how legacy CRM falls short of real relationship intelligence, and today their platform is used by 3300 + investment firms. We noticed a similar gap in portfolio management and performance tracking, where manual work and nonexistent data were the norm. Driven by our own frustrations, we co-founded, seeded, and led the series A for Standard Metrics, which has grown to over 100 top investment firms and 7000+ companies while revolutionizing the efficiency and quality of data collection, portfolio analytics, and reporting. Now, building on the data foundation they created, they have launched Global Benchmarking, adding deep utility and macro awareness to match their micro abilities.

INTERVIEW
SEP 3, 2024
Ramp & Vercel Fireside Chat

We were thrilled to host June's Chat8VC event alongside our portfolio companies Ramp & Vercel in NY. We were honored to feature Nik Koblov (Head of Engineering) and Nico Bevacqua (Head of UI / UX Engineering) from Ramp as well as Guillermo Rauch (CEO) and Lee Robinson (VP Product) from Vercel for a discussion anchored around the future of frontend engineering.

NEWS
JUN 5, 2024
Announcing Our Investment in iCOMAT

While most discussion of aviation breakthroughs focuses on areas like VTOL, advanced fuels, electrification, or autonomy, weight is a universal concern. In commercial aircraft, lowering costs through methods including weight reduction has helped expand access to air travel from an estimated 383 million global air passengers in 1970 to almost 4.5 billion in 2019. In defense, weight reduction means greater range - increasingly critical with conflict looming in the Indo-Pacific. In recent decades, weight reduction has largely involved replacing metals with composites - most notably in Airbus’ A350 and Boeing’s 787 Dreamliner, with total reduction estimated at 20%. 

APR 30, 2024
Scalable AI Architectures

Today, two neural architectures scale to the limits of available data and compute:

AI
NEWS
FEB 27, 2024
OpenGov: A Changing Guard; A Continuing Mission

Today, OpenGov announced its acquisition by Cox Enterprises for $1.8 billion USD. 

INTERVIEW
NOV 28, 2023
Michel Tricot (Airbyte) Fireside Chat

Our story is certainly full of ups and downs. Airbyte today is often associated with our open source data infrastructure project and product. It really started though in July 2019 when my co-founder and I first decided to build something together. We implemented a fairly disciplined system around idea exploration and honed in on the problem-space of data and went through YC in January ‘20, which was the famous COVID batch where we went from being in person to fully remote.

PODCASTS
APR 19, 2023
Drew Oetting On Building An $8 Billion Venture Capital Firm To Invest In Startups That Are Fixing Our Broken World

Drew Oetting is one of the biggest forces providing the financial fuel this new generation of fast-growing, super-sized startups need to make it. His venture capital firm, 8VC, has invested in startups like Unlearn, Chaos, Tome, and Ushur.

INTERVIEW
MAY 6, 2025
Joe Chen and Jonathan Shen (Upwork) Fireside Chat

We were thrilled to feature Joe and Jonathan from Upwork at March's Chat8VC in San Francisco. We covered their journey from teams like Google Brain and Cruise, and their own startup, to leading AI efforts at Upwork—building Uma, a suite of specialized LLMs powering workflows for freelancers and clients across the platform.

NEWS
APR 30, 2025
Clear Eyes, Fuzzy Joins, Can’t Lose: Announcing Our Investment in Structify

Human-quality workflows need human-quality data, an axiom that has only grown truer in the AI-first enterprise. However, access to complete, high-signal data remains a limiting factor, given steep data provider fees, inflexible schemas, AI hallucinations, and scattered, inconsistent, and mutating sources. Customers don’t need to be data scientists to recognize shovel-ready datasets, but if they need to be data scientists to generate them reliably, data will always be rate-limiting.

APR 9, 2025
Quantifying the Impact of GenAI Developer Tools

It’s widely agreed that GenAI will transform software development, and GenAI dev tools have emerged as cornerstones of 8VC’s portfolio and broader AI productivity thesis. Up to now, however, hard data on the scale and specifics of this shift have been missing from the equation. In competitive industries, the speed and efficiency gains promised by GenAI coding tools could well mean the difference between market leadership and obsolescence. Companies can’t afford to select the wrong tools and end up on the wrong side of the AI adoption curve.

NEWS
APR 8, 2025
Glimpse's $10M Series A to Rescue CPG Margins

For many consumers, the grocery aisle is the avatar of post-COVID inflation. Even as headline inflation has cooled (from 9.1% in June of 2022 to 2.8% in February of 2025), food prices remain stubbornly high, driving popular perceptions of gouging. $10 egg cartons, once confined to artisanal producers in Portland who know every hen by name, have hit big box stores. But grocery is a famously low-margin industry, and for CPG brands, the cost of doing business can be prohibitive.

 {

/* Snippet gets rid of top margin on first element in any rich text*/
.w-richtext>:first-child {
	margin-top: 0;
}

/* Snippet gets rid of bottom margin on last element in any rich text*/
.w-richtext>:last-child, .w-richtext ol li:last-child, .w-richtext ul li:last-child {
	margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* Snippet prevents all click and hover interaction with an element */
.clickable-off {
	pointer-events: none;
}

/* Snippet enables all click and hover interaction with an element */
.clickable-on{

}

.container-medium, .container-small, .container-large {

Charles is the Founding Vice President of Engineering at Together AI, where he leads the company’s work on AI infrastructure and clusters. Previously, he was Head of Applied Machine Learning at Snorkel AI and held engineering roles at Apple. He studied Computer Science at Stanford and has helped steer Together from an early contributor to open-source AI to a full-stack infra platform.</em></p><p><em>You might know their team from their algorithmic and data work on projects like FlashAttention and RedPajama. In this convo, Charles shared his experience scaling both hardware and systems engineering at Together, as well as their team’s philosophy around efficient AI: bridging breakthroughs in model architectures with low-level optimizations in networking, kernel design, and cluster reliability. We cover the challenges of running physical infrastructure at scale, lessons learned from handling esoteric GPU failures, and Together’s ambitions to support both high-scale model training and the next wave of small models for fast inference. </em></p><p><em>As a reminder, Chat8VC is a monthly series hosted at our SF office where we bring together founders and early-phase operators excited about the foundation model ecosystem. We focus on highly technical, implementation-oriented conversations, giving builders the chance to showcase what they’re working on through lightning demos and fireside chats.</em></p><p><em>If this conversation resonates and you'd like to get involved—or join us at a future event—reach out to Vivek Gopalan (</em><a href="http://vivek@8vc.com"><em>vivek@8vc.com</em></a><em>) and Bela Becerra (</em><a href="mailto:bela@8vc.com"><em>bela@8vc.com</em></a><em>).</em></p><h4><strong>Excited to have Charles here with us. Before we dive into tooling and infrastructure, let’s take a step back. What’s it been like building Together during this intense period of demand in AI?</strong></h4><p><strong>Charles (Together):</strong> Yeah, it's been a wild ride. We run our own infrastructure - actual physical clusters - which is a massive challenge. You’re talking about deploying GPUs and building site processes, in addition to all the software we ship - it’s not purely virtual. It’s very real, and that complexity is a big part of our day-to-day. But it’s also what makes it fun. And we’re growing a lot. </p><p><strong>Vivek:</strong> Many AI-native companies are facing similar growth stories and challenges – though not with hardware and at the same level of the stack that you guys are dealing with. </p><h4><strong>When you look at the open-source AI ecosystem – what’s missing? What would you tell future founders in this room to build to support some of the challenges that you’re running into?</strong></h4><p><strong>Charles: </strong>The obvious gap is good data. Clean, diverse, high-quality datasets are still hard to come by. That’s why we launched RedPajama early on. We saw the need - there was a lack of really good data to train models and explore LLMs - and tried to help fill it. That’s a big thing people need to contribute back to open source AI. </p><p>The other big one is tooling for reinforcement learning. As reasoning models get better, the ability to steer and refine them through RL becomes more powerful. But the tools still lag behind.</p><p><strong>Vivek: </strong>Yeah, and we've seen a bunch of people who are working on products to help with the post-training lifecycle!</p><h4><strong>Part of why we're here today is to talk about Together GPU clusters. Maybe tell us a little bit more about that. What kinds of companies are using them? Why go and expand in this route rather than just being pure inference as a service? </strong></h4><p><strong>Charles: </strong>We have GPUs and people can rent them and actually use them to train models, run inference, or do whatever they need. These are H100s, H200s, and we’ll have GB200s and B200s soon. We set you up with Slurm or Kubernetes or whatever you want – and make sure everything works well so that on day one, you can be productive.</p><p>We use these clusters ourselves for our inference service, for continuous training, and for our internal research. They’re designed by AI engineers and researchers, for AI engineers and researchers.</p><p>The reason we’re doing this ties back to our broader mission. We want to offer a holistic platform for LLMs, and compute infrastructure is a critical piece. If you're doing anything serious with LLMs, reliable compute is table stakes. We think this is a core part of the product.</p><h4><strong>As you scale these clusters to 10K, 50K, 100K GPUs, what are the biggest challenges that you guys have run into? Whether it's kernel optimization or networking, or something else? </strong></h4><p><strong>Charles</strong>: Yeah, I mean I think the most common issues that we see in these clusters are the same ones that you’d see in the Llama technical report – GPUs falling out of the bus all the time, ECC errors in the GPUs, etc. But some of the more surprising things are around kernels and hardware reliability.</p><p>We’ve had issues with overheating transceivers. At one point we literally walked around the data center with an infrared camera to see what was running too hot and out of spec. That kind of low-level ops – it wasn’t what I thought I’d be doing when I started this job.</p><p>And then you start learning about things like: how do objects get cleaned off the optical fiber so that your Infiniband doesn’t flap and cause your training to slow down? These are deep physical-world problems. I didn’t expect to have to get this far into that layer, but you need it if you want to run clusters reliably.</p><h4><strong>How do you think about ops overhead at that scale? How much can you rely on automation? Or do you literally have people walking around with IR cameras?</strong></h4><p><strong>Charles: </strong>Yeah, it’s both. At our scale, we can’t function without a ton of automation. We’ve got agents running on every machine, monitoring GPU utilization, thermals, failures and paging the team when something goes wrong.</p><p>But then, yeah, someone might have to walk into the data center. Maybe it’s rebooting a node. Maybe it’s replacing a bad cable. The systems are built to self-report, but the physical work still has to happen. These aren’t abstract cloud resources. They're real servers that need care and feeding.</p><h4><strong>And when you look at the broader market, there are a lot of people offering inference and renting out compute. What’s your core competency and what’s hard for others to replicate?</strong></h4><p><strong>Charles: </strong>At Together, our focus is efficient AI. And to us, efficiency spans both the model side, algorithm design, and the infra side, kernel tuning, systems optimization, etc.</p><p>So when you rent a GPU cluster from us, you’re not just getting bare metal. You get access to our Together Kernel Collection. This is a suite of custom kernels that we’ve optimized to make training faster and more efficient. Drop them into your training loop, and you might see 10%+ improvements out of the box.</p><p>And we’ve been through the pain ourselves. We operate these clusters not just for customers, but for our own research and services. That operational experience compounds. When you’re running 10K+ GPU clusters and keeping them reliable for your own workloads, you learn what matters.</p><h4><strong>Let’s talk about R1 for a second. R1 distillation showed you can compress a big model down to something like a 32B and still get impressive performance. How does that change your infrastructure planning? Do you worry about building for giant models only to have people prefer smaller ones? Do you risk infra obsolescence if models stay in this mid-sized range? </strong></h4><p><strong>Charles:</strong> Yeah, I think about that a lot. And it’s lucky for us because even though you can distill a model like R1 and get great performance at 70B, there’s still real demand for full-sized versions and more use-cases open up for smaller ones. </p><p>I was literally talking to someone tonight about this as we host DeepSeek, and they asked: “Are you hosting the big one?” People still want the big one! Especially in research, pretraining, frontier work. The appetite is there.</p><p>So when we build infra, we build it to support both. That means really fast Infiniband, fully non-blocking topologies, so we can support fully-distributed large models. But the same setup also runs small models just fine. It’s about flexibility.</p><h4><strong>And what about the extreme end like the 1B, 3B models that can run locally? We’re big believers in local AI here having invested in Ollama early. Do you see Together extending toward the edge with something in the middle like edge points-of-presence colocated close to where end users are but not quite in the cloud? Is that a real problem today or something more 3-4 years out? </strong></h4><p><strong>Charles: </strong>Yeah, totally. I actually think that problem is real today even without super-small models.</p><p>Latency matters. A lot of inference use cases like AI companions and phone calls are super latency-sensitive. People don’t want to wait. So we’re already thinking about edge POPs, routing, co-locating inference close to the user. We’ve even had to tackle this latency problem already and plan this out even with our large models – to figure out how we build an edge network and reduce latency no matter where the request is coming from. </p><p>The smaller models just make that more viable and you should see a lot of people playing around with them. You could imagine a hierarchy with device, then edge, then a really big hub data center, and that opens up some really interesting architectural ideas. Like treating the device as an extension of our cloud. </p><h4><strong>Maybe one last thing to close us out. We've got a lot more compute coming online over the next year or two, and you guys are obviously continuing to scale fast. What's one thing that keeps you up at night and what are you most bullish and excited about right now?</strong></h4><p><strong>Charles: </strong>I think the thing that keeps me up at night is that GPUs don't sleep. I'll get paged in the middle of the night and I’m just making sure everything keeps running. Literally Pagerduty keeps me up at night. </p><p>As we scale, the surface area just explodes. We’re at something like 160 people now, and the infra footprint is massive. It’s a lot of responsibility. </p><p>I’m also super excited. The most recent model releases like Qwen and Deepseek, and what we’ve seen with open models and smaller ones are game changers for accessibility. We’re going to see a huge wave of people suddenly able to run GPT-level models on their laptops.</p><p>That’s super cool and I can’t wait to see what people will do with it.</p></div><a href="#" class="resource-external-link is-relative w-inline-block w-condition-invisible"><div class="card_bottom-info is-horizontal-view is-align-left"><div class="card-tag"><div class="small-polygon-svg w-embed"><svg fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

However, access to complete, high-signal data remains a limiting factor, given steep data provider fees, inflexible schemas, AI hallucinations, and scattered, inconsistent, and mutating sources. Customers don’t need to be data scientists to recognize shovel-ready datasets, but if they need to be data scientists to generate them reliably, data will always be rate-limiting. </p></div><div class="card-small-thumbnail hide-mobile-landscape"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/635154aa7d0a29a9ed041ba2/68126ebb2400a403ef20d132_structify-blog-og%20(2).png" loading="eager" alt="" sizes="(max-width: 767px) 100vw, 11vw" srcset="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/635154aa7d0a29a9ed041ba2/68126ebb2400a403ef20d132_structify-blog-og%20(2)-p-500.png 500w, https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/635154aa7d0a29a9ed041ba2/68126ebb2400a403ef20d132_structify-blog-og%20(2)-p-800.png 800w, https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/635154aa7d0a29a9ed041ba2/68126ebb2400a403ef20d132_structify-blog-og%20(2)-p-1080.png 1080w, https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/635154aa7d0a29a9ed041ba2/68126ebb2400a403ef20d132_structify-blog-og%20(2)-p-1600.png 1600w, https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/635154aa7d0a29a9ed041ba2/68126ebb2400a403ef20d132_structify-blog-og%20(2).png 2000w" class="resource-img"></div></div></a><a href="#" class="resource-external-link w-inline-block w-condition-invisible"></a></div><div role="listitem" class="resource-item bg-white w-dyn-item"><a href="/resources/quantifying-the-impact-of-genai-developer-tools" class="item w-inline-block"><div class="border-line is-lightgrey has-margin-bottom" style="width: 0rem;"><div class="resource-hover-line"></div></div><div class="card_bottom-info is-2-col"><div class="card-bottom_left _2-0"><div class="card-tag"><div data-element-dot="" class="small-polygon-svg w-embed hide"><svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 8 8" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded' , () => {
    document.querySelector('.page-wrapper').classList.add('loaded');
})
// Custom Code for Menu
let navMenuOpen = false
let hamburgerBtn = document.querySelector('[hamburger-btn]')
hamburgerBtn.addEventListener('click' , () => {
  navMenuOpen = !navMenuOpen
  if(navMenuOpen){
    document.querySelector('[nav-menu]').style.pointerEvents = 'auto'
  }else{
    document.querySelector('[nav-menu]').style.pointerEvents = 'none'
  }
})


// Safari assets load
$(window).bind("pageshow", function(event) {
    if (event.originalEvent.persisted) {
        window.location.reload() 
    }
});
    
$('.company-card-bg-colour').each(function () {
	if (! $(this).attr("style") == 'background-color' || $(this).attr("style") == null ) {
		$(this).css({'background': '#7000ff'})  
	}
})


let richTexts = document.querySelectorAll(".w-richtext")
if(richTexts.length>0){
  richTexts.forEach(rt => {
    if(rt.firstChild){
        if(rt.firstChild.classList.contains("w-richtext-figure-type-image")){
            rt.firstChild.style.marginTop = "0.4rem"
        }else{
            rt.firstChild.style.marginTop = "0px"
        }
    }
  })
}



if( $('html').hasClass('w-editor') ) {
	$(window).on("load",function(){setTimeout(function(){$(".page-wrapper").removeClass("loaded")},20)});
}

/// Set Stickybars position
let navHeight = document.querySelector("[navbar]").clientHeight
let stickyBars = document.querySelectorAll("[set-nav-offset]")
if(stickyBars.length>0){
    stickyBars.forEach((ele) => {
        ele.style.top = (navHeight - 1) + "px"
    })
}
//button-second-text.js
//the text for the second line is duplicated for all buttons

let allButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.button');
let allExternalButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.external-button');

allButtons.forEach(button => {
    let mainTextContent = button.querySelector('.button-text_content');
    let secondTextContent = button.querySelector('.is-second');

    if (secondTextContent !== null) {
        secondTextContent.textContent = mainTextContent.textContent;
    }
});
  
allExternalButtons.forEach(button => {
    let mainTextContent = button.querySelector('.button-text_content');
    let secondTextContent = button.querySelector('.is-second');

    if (secondTextContent !== null) {
        secondTextContent.textContent = mainTextContent.textContent;
    }
});  

//menu-quick-links.js
//Adds menu animation, because there were some bugs in webflow

let menuStatus = true;
document.querySelector('.nav-button').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (menuStatus == true) {
        document.querySelector('.nav_quick-links').classList.toggle('nav_quick-links--hidden');
        menuStatus = false;
    } else {
        setTimeout(() => {
            document.querySelector('.nav_quick-links').classList.toggle('nav_quick-links--hidden');
        }, 1500);
        menuStatus = true;
    }
});



// Hide collection list if there are no items in collection
document.querySelectorAll(".w-dyn-empty").forEach(ele => {
  if(ele.parentElement.children.length == 1){
    ele.closest(".w-dyn-list").style.display = "none";
  }
})

// Add condition visibility to dots and line in resource/blog card
let resource_dots = document.querySelectorAll(`[data-element-dot]`)
if(resource_dots.length > 0){
    resource_dots.forEach(dot => {
        let format_text = dot.closest('.card-tag').querySelector('[data-element-format]')
        let category_text = dot.closest('.card-tag').querySelector('[data-element-category]')
        let dash_line = dot.closest('.card-tag').querySelector('[data-element-line]')
        if(format_text.offsetWidth === 0 && category_text.offsetWidth === 0){
            dot.classList.add("hide")
            dash_line.classList.add("hide")
        }
    })
}
//
let AllPageinks = document.querySelectorAll('a');
let filterPageLinks = [];
for (let i = 0; i < AllPageinks.length; i++) {
    let href = AllPageinks[i].getAttribute('href');
    let target = AllPageinks[i].getAttribute('target');
    
    if (href && !href.startsWith('#') && !href.startsWith('?') && (!target || target !== '_blank')) {
        filterPageLinks.push(AllPageinks[i]);
    }
}

$(filterPageLinks).on('click', function(event) {
    if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.shiftKey) return;
    document.querySelector('[page-transition-out]').click()
});

// Update Copyright year automatically
document.querySelector("#copyright-year-text").innerHTML = "©" + new Date().getFullYear();

$('[count="Video"]').text(videosNumber);


// Scrolled into view handler
function isScrolledIntoView(elem) {
	var docViewTop = $(window).scrollTop();
	var docViewBottom = docViewTop + $(window).height();

	var elemTop = $(elem).offset().top;
	var elemBottom = elemTop + $(elem).height();

	return ((elemBottom <= docViewBottom) && (elemTop >= docViewTop));
}

$(window).scroll(function () {
    $('.line,.char').each(function () {
        if (isScrolledIntoView(this) === true) {
            $(this).addClass('animate-text');
        }
    });
    $('.faded-text').each(function () {
        if (isScrolledIntoView(this) === true) {
        		$(this).css({'opacity': '1', 'transform': 'translate3d(0%,-20px,0) scale3d(1,1,1)'});
            
        }
    });
    $('.fade-in-btn').each(function () {
        if (isScrolledIntoView(this) === true) {
            $(this).attr('data-anim', 'fade');
            $(this).attr('data-delay', '450');
            $(this).css({'opacity': '1', 'transform': 'translate3d(0,-20px,0) scale3d(1,1,1)'});
        }
    });

});

<script>
//read-time.js
//counts the number of minutes needed to read

let array__readTimeRichElements = document.querySelectorAll('.read-time-rich-text');
array__readTimeRichElements.forEach(richText => {
    let str = richText.textContent;
    let widgetHiddenTextLength = str.replace(/\s+/g, '').length;
    let currentReadingTime = widgetHiddenTextLength / 1192;
    currentReadingTime = Math.round(currentReadingTime);
    if (currentReadingTime < 1) {
        currentReadingTime = 1;
    }
    //console.log(str);
    let currentLabel = richText.parentElement.querySelector('.read-time-rich-text_label');
    currentLabel.textContent = (currentReadingTime + ' min');
    
    let currentLabel2 = richText.parentElement.querySelector('.read-time-rich-text_label-2');
    currentLabel2.textContent = (currentReadingTime + ' min');
    
});
</script>

Leonidas Product Brief

The next war is here. A new era of conflict has seenadversaries exploiting vulnerabilities using asymmetrictactics. As these tactics evolve, our future depends onbuilding solutions that are better, faster, and moreaffordable.

Our Mission

​We are dedicated to overcoming the asymmetric challenges inherent to the future of national security.

Capabilities

Epirus combines the latest in solid-state, long-pulse high-power microwave systems with AI and advanced electronics to protect and sustain civilization.

Layered Short-Range Air Defense

Our software-defined, long-pulse HPM systems, either fixed or semi-fixed, can integrate with other sensors and weapons platforms to provide layered short-range air defense for counter-drone and drone swarm protection.

Learn More
Maneuver Short-Range Defense

The scalable nature of our software-defined, long-pulse HPM systems allow for electronic warfare capabilities on the go - whether placed on unmanned surface vessels for vessel stoppage, or hitched to vehicles for convoy security against drone swarms.

Learn More
Long-Range HPM Air Defense

Epirus provides testing and validation for range, capability, and limitations of electronic effects on long-range targets, and develops long-pulse HPM capabilities to defend high-value assets.

Learn More
Compact Electronic Warfare

Epirus Pod can embed within any platform, or even be carried by hand, to provide compact long-pulse HPM effects - for use cases ranging from de-mining to special operations.

Learn More
Air Domain Awareness

Regain dominance over your air domain picture using Epirus’ always-on perception capabilities. Continuously monitor, track, identify, and recommend actions to mitigate the threat of UAS incursions over vast areas - powered by big data and machine learning.

Learn More
Advanced Electronics

Our disruptive approach to advanced electronics combines hardware, software, and AI capabilities to meet the high-power performance needs of the most innovative use cases and the most demanding industries.

<script>

$(document).ready(function () {
  // Variable to track enable/disable state of the navbar background changes
  var enableBackgroundChange = true;

  if ($("[nav-bg-trigger]").length) {
    // Elements with [nav-bg-trigger] are present, set up ScrollTrigger instances
    $("[nav-bg-trigger]").each(function (index) {
      ScrollTrigger.create({
        trigger: $(this),
        start: "top 5%",
        end: "bottom 5%",
        onEnter: () => {
          if (enableBackgroundChange) {
            $(".navbar_bg").css("opacity", "1");
            enableBackgroundChange = false;
          }
        },
        onLeave: () => {
          //enableBackgroundChange = false; // Disable background changes
        },
        onEnterBack: () => {
          $(".navbar_bg").css("opacity", "1");
        },
        onLeaveBack: () => {
          if (!$(".w-nav-button").hasClass("w--open")) {
          $(".navbar_bg").css("opacity", "0");
            }
          enableBackgroundChange = true; // Re-enable background changes
        },
      });
    });

    // Setup hover event handler for .navbar_component
    if ($(window).width() > 991) {
      $(".navbar_component").hover(
        function () {
          if (
            enableBackgroundChange &&
            $(".navbar_bg").css("opacity") === "0"
          ) {
            $(".navbar_bg").css("opacity", "1");
          }
        },
        function () {
          if (
            enableBackgroundChange &&
            $(".navbar_bg").css("opacity") === "1"
          ) {
            $(".navbar_bg").css("opacity", "0");
          }
        }
      );
    } else {
      $(".navbar_menu-button.w-nav-button").click(function () {
        let currentOpacity = $(".navbar_bg").css("opacity") === "1" ? "0" : "1";
        $(".navbar_bg").css("opacity", currentOpacity);
      });
    }
  } else {
    $(".navbar_bg").css("opacity", "1"); // Default to opaque if no triggers are present
  }
});
</script>

<script>
document.querySelectorAll('[growing-animation-trigger]').forEach(triggerEl => {
  const duration = triggerEl.getAttribute('animation-time') || 1;
  const startPosition = triggerEl.getAttribute('animation-start') || 'top+=40% bottom';

  // Find elements specifically within this triggerEl for animation
  const targets = triggerEl.querySelectorAll('[growing-animation="opacity"]');

  targets.forEach(target => {
    const video = target.querySelector('video');
    if (video) {
      video.pause(); // Pause the video initially when the script runs
    }
  });

  gsap.from(targets, {
    height: 0,
    opacity: 0,
    duration: parseFloat(duration),
    ease: 'power2.out',
    stagger: 0.3,  // Stagger the animations for the targets
    scrollTrigger: {
      trigger: triggerEl,
      start: startPosition, // Use the custom or default start position
      toggleActions: 'play none none none',
      onEnter: () => {
        targets.forEach(target => {
          const video = target.querySelector('video');
          if (video) {
            gsap.to(target, {
              onComplete: () => {
                video.play();  // Play the video once the animation is completely finished
              }
            });
          }
        });
      }
    }
  });
});
</script>
